name: AMP2-P001 plate setup
description: Carbon-source comparison plate. Rows A-D carry the plate-level LB batch; rows E-H override to the M9 + 0.4% glucose batch through AMP2WellMetadata.media_ref.

name: AMP2-P002 plate setup
description: CRISPRi induction dose-response plate. One plate-level medium for every well (no per-well media_ref overrides); the experimental variable is the per-well vanillate concentration carried in AMP2WellMetadata.treatments.

name: AMP2-P003 plate setup
description: Full-panel 384-well plate: all 15 user samples x 6 technical replicates in each of four media quadrants (A-H/01-12 LB, A-H/13-24 M9+glucose, I-P/01-12 M9+benzoate, I-P/13-24 YPD). Demonstrates that the data model is not limited to 96-well geometry.
